payload.name: build-this-apps-screen
payload.description: Show this app's saved home screen and check that it opened.
payload.why_this_action_exists: An app can include a home screen without showing it. This action opens the saved home screen and checks each part before reporting success.

payload.name: show-current-application-screen-on-selection
payload.description: Show the selected home screen as soon as it becomes available.

payload.name: archive-layout-preset
payload.description: Archive one canonical layout_preset owner record.

payload.name: publish-layout-presets
payload.description: Read canonical layout_preset attribute facts and publish the addressed layout-presets sink payload.

payload.name: arrange-workspace
payload.description: Rearrange the workspace by placing named surfaces into coarse regions. The screen-arrangement slot lowers the declarative placements to a valid tiled layout; the result is written to the canonical layout-state SSOT so the live workspace re-renders (same address a human drag writes).

placements.description: Ordered surface placements. Each item is {"surfaceId":<id from the surface catalog>,"region":<region>} where region is one of left|right|top|bottom|center|overlay|floating. Use ONLY the surface id from the catalog — the workspace resolves it to the real surface automatically. Example: [{"surfaceId":"chat","region":"left"},{"surfaceId":"vision-board","region":"right"},{"surfaceId":"saved-links","region":"bottom"}].

focusTabId.description: Optional surface tab id to focus after arranging.

payload.name: record-application-composition-selection
payload.description: Save the selected app layout at its declared address so the current screen can open and update.
